headline: 🪟 NetScaler deadline day brings Mandiant's WHIPSHOT/SLAPSHOT campaign report on root-level exploitation, 👮 FBI brands Umbreon an alleged ShinyHunters leader facing murder-incitement charges, 🖨️ GreyNoise's agentic PaperCut campaign confirmed in a real education-sector breach, 🔑 OpenSSL CVE-2026-84782 DTLS heap-leak patched alongside a WolfSSL wave, 🤖 Autonomous AI agent breaches DIVD while rogue Plus 5.6 GPTs push RATs, ☁️ Microsoft ties JADEPUFFER Azure attacks to Storm-3168
summary: Deadline day on the NetScaler zero-days leads: Mandiant and GTIG detailed root-level exploitation with named tooling as the federal patch clock ran out, and the Umbreon arrest escalated into an alleged ShinyHunters leadership charge with murder-incitement counts and an FBI surrender call. Agentic AI ran through the day's research side, from GreyNoise's confirmed PaperCut breaches and DIVD's autonomous-agent intrusion to Microsoft tying JADEPUFFER's destructive Azure attacks to Storm-3168 and the UK AISI's GPT-6 Astra findings.
